name: MQ-2-Json Banking Api (Search Summary)
description:
Latest Revision 2.0.0.7940

Rest API Exposing Teiresias MQ Services.Authentication of this API is based on OAUTH2 Credential Flow.For Authentication you will need your created ClientId and ClientSecret which can be obtained from https://auth.teiresias.gr Authentication Server.

Authentication Server for TEST Env can be invoked using curl like below:

curl --request POST
--url 'https://auth.teiresias.gr/connect/token'
--header 'content-type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded'
--data grant_type=client_credentials
--data client_id=YOUR_CLIENT_ID
--data client_secret=YOUR_CLIENT_SECRET
--data scope=qanda_api_test

Sample Output

{
'access_token': eyJhbGciOiJBMjU2S1ciLCJlbmMiOiJBMjU2Q0JDLUhTNTEyIiwidHlwIjoiYXQrand0In02sda0dj12ea
'token_type' : Bearer
'expires_in' : 86399
}

Test Data is given from Tiresias via email per request. The Data isn't for any kind of regression or business tests. This Sandbox is only for integration testing.
